result.summary: Found a few layout/content clipping issues: a restaurant name is truncated in the Fastest near you row, and the category filter chips appear cut off on the right without a clear affordance beyond the intentional partial last item.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the third card in the 'Fastest near you' section, so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure card width and text truncation (ellipsis) still leave enough of the name visible; test with longer restaurant names.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ends abruptly with a partial 'Healthy' chip and a faint next chip, which is acceptable for horizontal scroll, but there is no strong visual cue that more categories exist beyond the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent peek of the next chip and optional fade/scroll indicator so users clearly understand the row is scrollable.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the truncated name ('€1.90 delivery') is fully visible while the name is not, creating an uneven card presentation in the horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Align text treatment across cards so names and meta lines use consistent max lines and truncation rules.
